info.title: API.SH: DXBinteract
info.description: The DXBinteract API from API.SH: public DXBinteract data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: DXBinteract leading Dubai areas (yield, price, demand)
get.description:
The leading Dubai communities from DXBinteract's Key Area Performance ranking: for each area the number of sales transactions, the median price per sq ft in AED and the gross rental yield, each with the previous period's value and last year's value and the change in percent, plus the upcoming supply in units and the share already sold. Areas carry the land registry's name (`area`), the community's market name (`master_project`, e.g. Jumeirah Village Circle) and the site's slug. `thin_data` marks figures from few transactions. Pick the period (3, 6 or 12 months), primary or resale sales, and apartments or villas; `area` keeps only the areas whose name matches. Every area of Dubai is in /dxbinteract/v1/areas.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-area-performance

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period the figures cover. Default 12m.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Primary (developer) sales, resales, or both. Default all.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Apartments, villas, or both. Default all.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Keep only areas whose name, market name or slug contains this text (e.g. jumeirah-village-circle, dubai marina). No match answers 404.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: DXBinteract figures for every Dubai area
get.description:
The same figures as /dxbinteract/v1/area-performance for every area of Dubai, not only the leading ones (about 200 areas, master communities and sub-areas): sales transactions, median price per sq ft in AED and gross rental yield with the previous period and last year and the change in percent, the upcoming supply and the share sold where the site has them. Areas with few or no sales have null figures and `thin_data` true. Use `area` to get one area.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-areas

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period the figures cover. Default 12m.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Primary (developer) sales, resales, or both. Default all.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Apartments, villas, or both. Default all.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Keep only areas whose name, market name or slug contains this text (e.g. mirdif, al-furjan). No match answers 404.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One day of Dubai property sales from the DXBinteract daily report: the number of sales transactions and their value in AED, split into primary (developer) and resale sales, the day-by-day figures of the 15 days ending on the date (weekends and days without registrations are not in the series), and the five best-selling projects of each market segment (off-plan apartments, off-plan villas, ready apartments, ready villas, plots) with their transaction count and value. For today the site's headline cards are in `summary`. `raw` holds the site's chart data. Dates are in Dubai time; the default is today.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-daily-report

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD (Dubai time). Default today; dates in the future are refused.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The off-plan projects of one Dubai area from DXBinteract's Offplan Hub: for each project its name, slug and id, the site's progress figure, availability (Available or Sold), completion date, property type, bedroom range and price range in AED, and per bedroom count the unit size range in sq ft, the median price and the units sold out of the total, with its image and DXBinteract page. Pick the area by the site's area id (31391 Business Bay, 31390 Downtown Dubai, 36510 Jumeirah Village Circle, 47263 Dubai Hills Estate, 31406 Palm Jumeirah, 31483 Dubai South; /dxbinteract/v1/unit-prices returns an area's id as `area_id`). An area without off-plan projects answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-offplan-projects

parameters.name: area_id
parameters.description: The site's area id, e.g. 31391 (Business Bay). One area per call; 1 (the whole of Dubai) is refused.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Registered Dubai rent contracts from DXBinteract, newest first, 15 per page: for each the building and area, property type, New or Renewed, bedrooms, size in sq ft, the yearly rent in AED, the rental yield over the unit's latest purchase price (percent), start and end dates, duration and the purchase price. Filter by area, project or building (`area`), bedrooms and sort.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-rentals

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: The site's area, project or building name as in its links, e.g. business-bay, dubai-marina, jumeirah-village-circle, palm-jumeirah, burj-khalifa. Default dubai (the whole of Dubai). An unknown name answers 404.

parameters.name: beds
parameters.description: studio or 1-7 bedrooms. Default all.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest, price-desc or price-asc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page, 1-50. Default 1; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Dubai's top property developers from DXBinteract (30, in the site's order), or one developer: name, slug, the site's developer id, year founded, a short overview, logo, the number of projects and properties tracked since 2012, this year's sales volume and value in AED (`sales_year`), the capital gain (median price change of resales over the last 12 months, in percent) and the absorption rate of projects under construction (percent). Pass `developer` (an id from the list, a slug such as emaar-properties, or the developer's DXBinteract link) for one developer, including developers outside the top 30. An unknown developer answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-top-developers

parameters.name: developer
parameters.description: One developer, by its id (e.g. 2), its slug (e.g. emaar-properties) or its DXBinteract link. Default the top 30.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Dubai property sale transactions from DXBinteract (Dubai Land Department records), newest first, 13 per page: for each the building and area, Ready or Offplan, property type, floor, the price in AED, the capital gain over the unit's previous sale (percent), price per sq ft, the loan-to-value when mortgaged, size, bedrooms, balcony size, the date, who sold (Individual or Developer), how many times the seller has sold, and the transaction's DXBinteract page. Filter by area, project or building (`area`), developer (`developer`: a developer's own sales across Dubai), bedrooms and sort.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-transactions

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: The site's area, project or building name as in its links, e.g. business-bay, dubai-marina, jumeirah-village-circle, palm-jumeirah, burj-khalifa. Default dubai (the whole of Dubai). An unknown name answers 404.

parameters.name: developer
parameters.description: The site's developer id, e.g. 2 (Emaar) or 7 (Sobha); /dxbinteract/v1/top-developers returns it as developer_id.

parameters.name: beds
parameters.description: studio or 1-7 bedrooms. Default all.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest, price-desc, price-asc, price-sqft-desc or price-sqft-asc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page, 1-50. Default 1; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: DXBinteract median prices by area and bedrooms
get.description:
Median sale prices for one unit size in one Dubai area, project by project, from DXBinteract's "prices by beds" pages: for each project the number of units, the size range in sq ft, the median price and the median price per sq ft in AED (computed by the site from recent transactions), its DXBinteract project page and image. Pick the area by the name in the site's links (business-bay, downtown-dubai, marsa-dubai for Dubai Marina, palm-jumeirah, dubai-creek-harbour, jumeirah-village-circle, jumeirah-lake-towers, palm-deira for Dubai Islands, madinat-al-mataar for Dubai South) or pass a page link. An area, bed count and type the site has no page for answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-unit-prices

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: The area's name as in the site's links (e.g. business-bay), or a page link such as https://dxbinteract.com/2-bed-apartment-for-sale-prices-in-business-bay (which also sets beds and type).

parameters.name: beds
parameters.description: Bedrooms, studio (or 0) or 1 to 9. Optional when area is a page link.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Unit type. Default apartment.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One week (Monday to Sunday) of Dubai property sales from the DXBinteract weekly report: the number of sales transactions and their value in AED, split into primary (developer) and resale sales, the same figures for each of the 20 weeks ending with it, and the five best-selling projects of each market segment (off-plan apartments, off-plan villas, ready apartments, ready villas, plots) with their transaction count and value. For the latest week `summary` adds the site's headline cards (value, volume and median price per sq ft with the week-on-week change). `latest_week_ending` is the newest week the site has published.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dxbinteract-weekly-report

parameters.name: week_ending
parameters.description: Any day of the week, YYYY-MM-DD; the report is for the Monday-to-Sunday week that contains it. Default the latest published week.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
